upstream.note: Clamor exposes this block as a read-only plan and is private to public CI. This record pins the inspected definition; CI verifies the adapted local materialization against this record and does not claim to query Clamor.

digestVerification.method: The upstream BlockDefinition was loaded at the pinned commit and definitionRef() was computed with Clamor's canonical kernel digest before materialization.

adaptations.rationale: Design spec 0005 requires every commit and PR title to conform; merge, nonconventional revert, and version messages cannot use Commitlint's default exemptions.

GitHub forms a squash body from the feature report after the protected PR gates run. Conventional Commit identity is carried by the validated squash title, so prose line wrapping must not create a post-merge-only rejection.
After exact staged-file formatting and linting, the advisory pre-commit transition runs the repository fast loop required by design spec 0005.

The project adds an advisory pre-push hook that clears Git hook-local repository variables before invoking the pinned Nix integration gate; this path is project-owned and absent from the upstream block.

deviationsFromBlock: commitlint.config.ts and .githooks/pre-commit begin from upstream renders but are intentionally hardened as recorded adaptations, so they are not claimed byte-identical to Clamor.
.githooks/pre-push is a project-owned lifecycle hook, not an upstream block claim.
The package also pins Bun, Oxfmt, Oxlint, and stable TypeScript 7 for this repository; those choices are outside the upstream block's claim set.

conformance.method: Checks immutable upstream identity fields, exact configured inputs, required adaptation records, content digests, semantic package keys, and executable modes. It verifies local conformance to this checked record without claiming a live private-upstream query.
